card: Adds a wallet database record that stores normalized public multipath descriptor strings and links them to the single-path receive and change descriptors they expand into. Currently, Bitcoin Core irreversibly splits multipath descriptors on creation or import, preventing users and external tools from retrieving the unified multipath descriptor needed for hardware wallet registration (such as BIP 388 policies in HWI). Exposes the multipath string in listdescriptors and getaddressinfo, and preserves records when exporting watch-only wallets.
changed_since_previous: Dependency PR #36230 was merged upstream; the implementation approach remains unchanged.
evidence: PR description: 'HWI recently added a registerdescriptor command (https://github.com/bitcoin-core/HWI/pull/842) which some hardware wallets require in order to (more safely) support multisig... Internally HWI converts the descriptor to a BIP388 policy. The only catch is that we need to provide a multipath descriptor, rather than separate receive and change descriptors. This PR makes that possible.'
Linked issue #36075 discusses alternative approaches to reconstructing or natively supporting multipath descriptors in the wallet.
problem: Bitcoin Core expands BIP 389 multipath descriptors into separate single-path receive and change descriptors upon creation or import, discarding the unified multipath string. Hardware wallet integrators (such as HWI using BIP 388 policies) require the single multipath descriptor to register multisig wallets and safely verify receive and change addresses on signing devices.

risk.why: Mistakes in writing or validating the new wallet database records during wallet loading can flag a database as corrupt and prevent users from opening their wallets.

scope_notes: The PR combines descriptor parser refactoring (transitioning parser functions to `util::Expected`, introducing `ParseState`, and extracting derivation helpers) with wallet DB additions and RPC extensions. The author notes that conceptual review on the approach is requested before detailed code review.
summary: Stores an auxiliary `multipathdescriptor` wallet database record mapping normalized public multipath descriptors to their constituent receive and change descriptor IDs. Updates descriptor parsing to optionally extract and normalize public multipath descriptor strings, merging hardened derivation prefixes into key origin info per BIP 388. Writes these records on wallet creation, `createwalletdescriptor`, and `importdescriptors`, preserves them during watch-only wallet export, and exposes them in `getaddressinfo` and `listdescriptors`.
